notes: Same RTX 4090 D service and retained eager flags (mix6 shape dispatch, fused kk-pre, fused lnx/rkvres/xg, fused cmix, direct linear, alternate recurrent plus fused T=1). Eight fixed prompts at concurrency=8, max_tokens=32, ignore_eos=true; five rounds after one warmup. The opt-in FP32 constant cache removes repeated BF16-to-FP32 casts of k_k, k_a and r_k during each attention decode.
